prompt: On the Search screen, the "Pager on call" badge next to the heading re-renders on every keystroke when I type in the incident filter, even though nothing about the badge changes. Find out why and fix it.

truth.summary: SearchScreen passes an inline `appearance` object literal to the memoized StatusBadge, so its identity changes on every render and memo never bails out.

referenceAnswer.cause: SearchScreen passes a new inline appearance object on every render, so memo's shallow prop comparison always fails.

acceptedAnswers.cause: SearchScreen recreates the appearance object on each keystroke, so memo's shallow comparison never bails out.

decoyAnswers.cause: The badge label string changes while typing.
StatusBadge is not wrapped in memo, so it re-renders with each new parent render.

referenceFix.replace:
import { type BadgeAppearance, StatusBadge } from './StatusBadge'

const pagerBadgeAppearance: BadgeAppearance = { tone: 'success', size: 'sm' }
